questions.question: What great event does Zephaniah 1 announce?
options: The long-awaited return of the exiles to the land
A coming time of lasting peace and great plenty
The great day of the LORD, near and hastening
The full rebuilding of the holy temple in Zion
questions.answer: The great day of the LORD, near and hastening

questions.question: Whom will God punish, including those who are complacent?
options: Those who flee away to the high mountains long before the great day comes
Those who mourn deeply in rough sackcloth on account of all of their sins
Those who keep the holy Sabbath and all of the appointed feasts most faithfully
Those who say in their hearts, 'The LORD will not do good, nor will he do ill'
questions.answer: Those who say in their hearts, 'The LORD will not do good, nor will he do ill'

questions.question: Zephaniah 1 describes the day of the LORD as a day of wrath, distress, and darkness.
The great day of the LORD is _____, near and hastening fast.
Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to _____ them on the day of the LORD's wrath.
